status: Repair audit, retrospective replication, case review and prospective shadow preparation; no public ranking replacement
repairPolicy: Add only verified missing game identities to season-specific known FCS nodes. Preserve conflicting or unknown evidence for review. Do not infer absence of FCS playoffs from provider seasonType labels.
modelPolicy: Identical unchanged Colley network for nested two-variable control and three-variable division challenger; fit both on the same FBS-involving older-season games. Separate prior-week-only and final-network excluded-game fits; no forced coefficient signs, polls, team overrides or parameter selection by current ranks.
replications: Provider regular-season labels only; this can retain actual early FCS playoff rounds and must not be called a true playoff exclusion
caseReview: Individual reference probabilities for each scheduled opponent
Separate parameter refit and direct subdivision term
FCS upset outcomes and proper scoring penalties
Strong FCS and weak FBS opponents can overlap; no forced team ordering
Count each outcome once; no extra division multiplier in the network or actual record
prospectivePolicy: Freeze a new separately versioned candidate after this analysis. Save shadow achievement comparisons and available future-game probabilities with immutable source/input/implementation checksums. Future forecasts must be recorded after freeze and before kickoff. Same-time achievement comparisons are not pregame forecasts.
operations: Use existing Sunday 08:00 America/Denver retrieval and evidence. No additional CFBD request, paid service, public formula change or frontend change. New research failures must not block publication or the existing frozen v1 comparison.
limits: Previously inspected historical seasons are not untouched evaluation
NCAA tournament coverage and non-NCAA FCS postseason require distinct checks
2020 spring championship falls in calendar 2021 and has source roster omissions
Predominantly FBS-home selected crossdivision schedules prevent causal population interpretations
Probability quality alone cannot establish a uniquely correct achievement order
